rules.concise: Be concise in explanations - prefer code over prose. Keep responses focused and actionable.
rules.shareContext: Share relevant context with other agents via sharedContext. Summarize before passing context.
rules.costOptimized: Use cheapest capable model for the task. Never exceed cost constraints.
backend: Focus on Java/Spring Boot code in backend/ directory
Write unit tests with JUnit and Mockito
Follow the existing package structure: com.guitartutorial.backend.*
frontend: Focus on React/TypeScript code in frontend/src/ directory
Use Vite for build and dev server
Follow Tailwind CSS conventions for styling
Write tests with Vitest and React Testing Library
Maintain the existing API client pattern in src/api/
Follow the existing page routing structure
docker: Focus on Dockerfile and docker-compose files
Keep dev and prod configurations separate
Follow security best practices for containers
fullstack: Coordinate changes across frontend and backend
Ensure consistent error handling across layers
Review cross-cutting concerns like auth, logging, monitoring
Orchestrate specialized agents for specific tasks
Summarize context before passing to other agents
Delegate to specialist agents when appropriate
testing: Write unit tests for backend (JUnit, Mockito)
Write component tests for frontend (Vitest, RTL)
Create integration tests for API endpoints
Use test containers for integration tests
modelRouting: Use cheapest model capable of completing the task
Upgrade model only if task complexity requires it
Never use models more expensive than claude-3-haiku-20240307
Prefer deepseek for standard development tasks
Use gemini-flash-lite for simple queries and reviews
tokenOptimization: Summarize long conversations before context exceeds 5000 tokens
Use references to previous context instead of repeating
Prefer diffs over full file contents when possible
